Name: Tent Recolor
Author: minkeycookie
Description:
I don't even use the tent kit that often, but it bothered me that it stood out against the recolors I used. It's just a quick edit of the tent I made for myself but maybe someone else will want it so here it is :) 

[font=Arial][size=5]Install[/size]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font]
[/list]
Use GMCM to select your preferred texture or go to the config.json

Config Options: blue, green, khaki, pink, yellow, hotpink, orange, mint, purple

[size=1]Maybe when I'm not lazy I'll make ones with patterns[/size]

Downloads.Description: Delete the Plains folder in the mod assets if you have it
